sources.title: Apache Iceberg reliability
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Delta Lake：樂觀並行控制與衝突重算
related.titleEn: Delta Lake: optimistic concurrency and conflict recomputation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：區分資料檔存在與已提交snapshot可見，追蹤失敗提交留下的孤兒檔。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Distinguish existing data files from committed-snapshot visibility and trace orphan files after failed commits. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 讓兩個writer讀同版資料，檢查commit競爭後何者需重算。
related.differenceEn: Have two writers read one version and determine which must recompute after competing commits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 表metadata指向snapshot/manifest，讀者依固定snapshot讀；原子metadata更新才改變可見版本。 教學基準：100+100 = 200 S1 visible rows；第二檢核：100+100+50 = 250 S2 visible rows after commit。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
樂觀並行控制先準備寫入，再驗證讀寫集合與新的表版本；不能把所有append與update視為同樣衝突。 教學基準：100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock；第二檢核：100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Table metadata points to snapshots/manifests and readers use fixed snapshots; atomic metadata changes alter visibility. Teaching baseline: 100+100 = 200 S1 visible rows; second check: 100+100+50 = 250 S2 visible rows after commit. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Optimistic concurrency prepares writes then validates read/write sets against new versions; appends and updates need not conflict identically. Teaching baseline: 100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock; second check: 100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Service Worker：離線快取與版本切換
related.titleEn: Service Worker: offline caches and version transitions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：區分資料檔存在與已提交snapshot可見，追蹤失敗提交留下的孤兒檔。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Distinguish existing data files from committed-snapshot visibility and trace orphan files after failed commits. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 建立每版cacheName與URL清單，模擬安裝成功、下載一檔失敗與離線開啟三種路徑。
related.differenceEn: Define cache names and URL lists; simulate complete install, one failed asset and offline opening.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

install、waiting與activate不是同一時刻；新worker與舊頁面並存時必須避免不相容資源混用。
教學基準：600+760 = 1360 KiB；對照：1360-600 = 760 KiB。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Table metadata points to snapshots/manifests and readers use fixed snapshots; atomic metadata changes alter visibility. Teaching baseline: 100+100 = 200 S1 visible rows; second check: 100+100+50 = 250 S2 visible rows after commit. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Install, waiting and activate occur at different times; new workers and old clients can coexist, requiring compatible resource versions.
Teaching baseline: 600+760 = 1360 KiB; comparison: 1360-600 = 760 KiB.
